title: A rapid and scalable method for visible light induced bromination of uracil derivatives in a falling film looping photoreactor
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34925-34937
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05774K, Paper
Open Access

Shibu Naskar, Susital Mal, Shivangi Shivangi, Subrata Das
A catalyst and oxidant-free bromination of uracil derivatives has been developed using N-bromosuccinimide under visible light irradiation with successive scalability.
